name: liangify
description: Michael Liang's personal Claude Code customizations — agents, commands, skills, and hooks shared across projects.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Language-agnostic foundations — clean-code (Uncle Bob), code-review and git-workflow skills, and the code-tutor teaching agent.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript language style — strict typing, narrowing, discriminated unions, branded types, generics. Framework-agnostic. Depends on `core`.

plugins.name: angular
plugins.description: Angular 22 skills — zoneless + signals patterns, RxJS and resources, Signal Forms and reactive forms, Vitest testing. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity 6 skills — C# scripting patterns, asset/GUID/meta hygiene for AI-assisted work, performance discipline, Test Framework + batchmode verification. Depends on `core`.

plugins.name: webgpu
plugins.description: WebGPU rendering skills — device setup and graceful failure, resource lifetime and device loss, WGSL style and uniform layout, shader/CPU geometry parity, GPU-free testing. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.

plugins.name: dicom-rt
plugins.description: DICOM and radiotherapy domain knowledge — patient coordinates and slice geometry, RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE/RTPLAN and rigid/deformable registration objects, DIMSE networking, synthetic test data rules, dose summation and EQD2 math. Depends on `core`.
